snippet.title: The Mirror of Erised | Full Scene | Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone
snippet.description:
Harry stumbles on the Mirror of Erised and, to his shock, sees his parents, James and Lily Potter, standing right beside him. Ron, however, sees himself as Head Boy and Quidditch captain. So what does it all mean? As Dumbledore explains, the Mirror of Erised shows a person's deepest and most desperate desires, leaving us with this note of wisdom: 'It does not do to dwell on dreams, Harry, and forget to live.'

The Harry Potter: Complete 8-Film Collection is available on Blu-ray and Digital now.

snippet.title: Harry Meets Dobby | Full Scene | Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
snippet.description:
Just when it's most important that Harry makes no noise and pretends he doesn't exist, he gets a visit from a house-elf named Dobby, who's determined to stop Harry from returning to Hogwarts for his own safety. He might be grateful for Harry's kindness, but that doesn't stop Dobby from doing everything in his power to keep Harry at Privet Drive. Join us as we relive the moment we met one of the most beloved characters in the wizarding world.
